$comment: Machine-readable k8s resource-budget FLOOR per deviceArchetype — the contract that was missing when adam under-provisioned silently (backlog archetype-resource-conformance-validation-gap.md). Each human's EFFECTIVE conductor resources (template humans: deployments.json edgenode* fields; explicit-manifest humans e.g. adam: the resources block in their manifest YAML) MUST be >= its archetype floor here. A human MAY exceed the floor for its role (e.g. adam, the genesis anchor + doorway-B backend + seed target, runs cpu limit 8000m vs the family-node-base 4000m floor). validate-deployments.ts enforces this (wired into .husky/pre-push). WHEN YOU BUMP an archetype's baseline sizing, bump the floor here in the same commit — the gate then flags any human left behind (which is exactly the adam/matthew 2026-06-15 propagation drift this closes). Floors seeded 2026-07-07 from the reconciled post-shem-relief baselines: non-family remote fixtures restore to 1000m CPU limit, while family-node anchors remain higher. Physical hardware specs live in devices.json / device-archetypes-design.md; this file is the k8s-budget projection of those, pending the design doc's not-yet-built 'operational envelope derivation'.
$alignmentPolicyComment: 2026-07-16: these values are now the CANONICAL per-archetype budget enforced by the archetype-resource-alignment epr-meta rule (.claude/epr-meta/policies.yaml), not merely a >= floor. A consolidated human MUST equal its archetype value unless it declares resourceOverride:{<field>,justification} in deployments.json (adam/jessica/james do). device-home-nuc cpuLimit 1000m->2000m: eve+gertrude (home-nuc) liveness-crashlooped at 1000m during post-outage DHT resync; 2000m covers observed ~1.1-core use + headroom. recycled-laptop/chromebook/pi stay at 1000m and lean on the template startupProbe (the real fix) instead of per-instance CPU inflation.

device-family-node-base.note: Genesis-pair anchor + doorway backend baseline (matthew). Anchors that also back a heavy doorway + seed traffic (adam) size ABOVE this floor; conductor db read pool = max(2*cpus,8) so >4000m limit lifts max_readers above the 8 floor.

device-recycled-laptop.$cpuLimitComment: 2026-08-09: 1000m -> 2000m, evidence-based class realignment. Every live instance of this class has required 2000m under real load: 2026-05-27 install-burst crashloop (susan+jessica bumped), 2026-08-03 susan 100% CFS throttle at the 1000m canonical (head_record_degraded budget_elapsed, acab4bf82), 2026-08-08 susan zero kitsune2 gossip attempts with CPU starvation the leading hypothesis (backlog susan-kitsune2-gossip-never-attempts.md). The 2026-07-16 down-realignment to 1000m assumed the failure class was liveness-probe-only; the throttle evidence contradicts that. Physical spec (4 cores i5-8250u, devices.json) comfortably covers 2000m. Per-instance cpu overrides on susan/jessica removed in the same commit (one class, one budget).
